title: Deposit renewed
description: Deposit renewal event. This event is generated when a deposit is renewed at maturity, starting a new term for the account.

product_id.title: Product ID
product_id.description: Product ID. Format is UUID v4.

term_start_date.title: Term start date
term_start_date.description: Start date of the renewed deposit term (reached maturity date plus one day). Displayed in RFC3339 format.

maturity_date.title: Maturity date
maturity_date.description: Maturity date of the renewed deposit term. Displayed in RFC3339 format.

renewal_datetime.title: Renewal date time
renewal_datetime.description: Timestamp indicating when the deposit renewal was processed. Displayed in RFC3339 format.

external_account_id.title: External account ID
external_account_id.description: A custom account ID string that uniquely identifies the account within your organization
